st_riviere.name: Quai des Pêcheurs
st_riviere.alt: A grassy bank of the river winding through the green wooded valley, with a big oak, a flower bed and a wooden post by the water; behind, a stone fisherman's cottage with a pale blue door, a little stone shed with an orange door and a wooden garden gate. Monsieur Verbe kneels by a washtub watching his toy boat sink; waters the flowers with a watering can; points up at a robin perched on the post; sits on the bank fishing; and catches flakes from a tiny gray cloud on his gloves. The path on the left leads back down the valley.

glacons.name: Impasse des Glaçons
glacons.alt: A shady, frosty bend of the river in winter, with icicles on the bare trees and thin ice at the water's edge; a little stone ice-house with a pale blue door is built into the bank. Monsieur Verbe blows on his hands as they turn to ice; stands frozen stiff, frosted from beret to boots; digs a ditch with a spade to drain a puddle; drops a pebble in a green beret and the water splashes back up at him; and flies a bird kite high over the river.

doors.label: Quai des Pêcheurs
doors.hint: Back through the pale blue door

etincelles.name: Rue des Étincelles
etincelles.alt: A sunny glade in the valley where a little stream tumbles over rocks into a round pond, with an old iron hand pump and a wooden bucket; an orange door is set in a stone wall on the left. Monsieur Verbe watches the stream pour into the pond, hand mirror in hand; pumps water into the bucket; holds up a sparkling diamond; sadly points at a plastic bottle in a gray puddle; and beams with joy, golden rays all around him.

graines.name: Chemin des Graines
graines.alt: A sunny vegetable garden on the riverbank, with cabbages and radishes in rows and the river and wooded hills behind; a wooden garden gate on the left and a blank wooden board on posts. Monsieur Verbe perches on a tall stool with a hand mirror; kneels by a flower pot where seeds are sprouting; points at the blank board like a museum guide; sunbathes in a deckchair with sunglasses; and strides along with a huge steaming cup of coffee.

doors.label: Quai des Pêcheurs
doors.hint: Back through the wooden garden gate
